description: Per-rule shadow log statistics: number of fires, per-bucket hit rates, distance from the 4-condition promotion bar (≥30/bucket, ≥15pp spread, direction match, no confounding shadow). Use when reviewing whether a contributor's rule is on track to graduate from log-only shadow to a real entry gate. Sourced from /data/rule_status.json, regenerated after each morning/evening sniper check.
name: get_rule_status
